title: Sprint-stitching and deployment rhythm playbook: schedule guardrails and cross-team signal matrix
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a pragmatic, repeatable playbook for stitching sprint plans into a reliable multi-surface deployment rhythm. The playbook defines a shared launch calendar template, a cross-team signal matrix (performance, cost, errors, UX regressions), gating rules (go/no-go), and contingency lanes for runtime/console/API rollouts. Goal: reduce orchestration friction, decrease missed rollbacks, and make launch decisions data-driven across engineering, design, and PM teams.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar template that maps sprint milestones to launch signals and owners
Signal matrix with thresholds for latency, 5xx rate, token-cost delta, and quality regressions
Runbook with explicit go/no-go checklist and rollback triggers
Automated calendar checks that flag capacity or blackout conflicts
Two rehearsals documented with learnings and follow-up action items
Per-release dashboard links embedded in the calendar for on-call and PM triage
tasks: Draft calendar template and example for runtime+console+API launch lanes
Solicit feedback from Runtime, Console, SDKs, and SRE leads
Build signal matrix and map each signal to an owner and dashboard
Define and document contingency lanes (regional fallback, model-variant fallback, capacity-reserve)
Write go/no-go checklist and embed into pre-launch checklist in Confluence
Prototype calendar automation rules and conflict detector (small script)

Playbook should be consumable in a 30-minute run-through for new release owners
